episode_refs.prompt: Dawn at sea: an old two-masted wooden sailing ship with patched grey sails and a small rowing boat hanging at its side lies at anchor in calm grey-blue water. Behind it, through drifting mist, a wild island covered in dense dark-green jungle rises to a single steep mountain in the middle, from whose summit a thin white thread of smoke climbs straight into the pale sky. Wide shot from the water.

The weathered wooden deck of an old sailing ship at dawn, coiled ropes, a ship's wheel, wet planks, mist and a jungle island visible beyond the rail. In the middle of the deck stands a big open wooden sea chest overflowing with a jumble of random things: tins of food, a lantern, a laptop with a tangled charger cable, a brass compass, umbrellas, a teapot, a hammer, a fishing rod, clothes, a radio, an old kettle, an hourglass, playing cards. Seen at eye level.

A wild beach on a tropical island: pale sand, low waves, a small empty wooden rowing boat pulled up on the sand, driftwood, and a wall of dense dark-green jungle right behind the beach. Above the treetops rises a single steep mountain with a thin white thread of smoke at its summit. Out on the misty sea, far away, an old two-masted sailing ship. Seen from the waterline at eye level.

A deep jungle gorge at dusk: two steep cliff edges overgrown with ferns and hanging vines, and between them a long old suspension footbridge of grey weathered wooden planks hung on two rusted iron chains, many planks missing, sagging over a bottomless misty drop and vanishing into fog toward the far side. On the near edge, beside the bridge's iron anchor, a waist-high moss-covered standing stone. Cold blue dusk light, drifting mist. Seen from the near edge at eye level. No people.

Close view of the bridge anchor on a jungle cliff at dusk: a waist-high standing stone covered in moss, carved with simple pictures only — two small human figures side by side, an old oil lantern, and a long row of short notches. Behind it, the rusted iron chain of the bridge runs over a big wooden wheel down to a huge round stone weight that rests on a wooden box full of sand, with a small wooden plug in a hole at the bottom of the box. An old iron oil lantern hangs from a hook on the stone. No letters, no text, no people.
